description: Bump the nix-hermes content-bundle pin (hermes_agent role) on each nix-hermes release.

A bespoke manager rather than a `# renovate:` annotation because the version is EMBEDDED in a flake URL. The shared annotation manager captures everything after the colon as currentValue, which for this var would be the whole `github:owner/repo/tag#output` string — not a version any datasource can resolve.
The file pattern covers both role-defaults layouts (`defaults/main.yml` and `defaults/main/*.yml`). Matching only the file form leaves this pin untracked with no warning the moment the role is split.

description: Restore the nix-hermes bundle pin's own extractVersion.

The shared preset carries a packageRule matching custom.regex + github-releases that force-sets extractVersion to ^v(?<version>.+)$. That is correct for upstreams whose tags are plain vX.Y.Z, and it silently breaks any whose tags are not: it OVERRIDES the extractVersionTemplate the manager declares, so nix-hermes tags (nix-hermes-vX.Y.Z) match nothing and every release is discarded before comparison. The datasource returns a populated mostRecentTimestamp alongside an EMPTY releases array, and the pin never proposes an update.

Reproduced by flattening the whole preset chain into one config and running a lookup dry-run: updates [] under the full chain, 0.12.0 under config:recommended plus this manager alone. Repo config merges after the preset, so re-stating extractVersion here wins without touching an org-wide rule other repos depend on.

packageRules.description: Hermes Agent updates are proposed for weekly manual compatibility review; keep its patch verification and plugin pins aligned.
OpenProject AIO majors need a deliberate sequential upgrade + bundled Postgres data migration (see #928). Block automatic major bumps; minor/patch still flow.
Keep ordinary Hindsight client updates below 1 until the plugin declares and passes compatibility with SDK 1.x; review vulnerability fixes manually for compatibility.
Disable ordinary SDK major proposals; vulnerability fixes can still propose major versions and require manual compatibility review.

Keep a digest on the Hindsight service image and manually review its tag with the compatible Hermes plugin/runtime pins. GHCR does not provide the release timestamp Renovate needs for minimumReleaseAge, so retain the inherited weekly schedule but allow the update to be proposed immediately for review.
Update the pgvector test fixture within PostgreSQL 17; database major changes need a separate migration review.
Hindsight plugin release tags need a manual Hermes compatibility review.
Track llama.cpp stable semantic-version releases and map the release to its binary build ID in role defaults.
Track Phoenix server tags written as version-<semver>. The docker versioning cannot order a tag with the version- prefix, so without this rule the image pin never receives an update proposal.
The agent_guest residual-deny policy pin is bumped only by a reviewed merge: Renovate proposes the nix-ai digest update there but never automerges it.
Keep the llm_router compiled requirements on the pip-compile manager.
Every LiteLLM release requires filelock below 4; hold it there until LiteLLM lifts that bound.
Vulnerability-fix PRs ignore allowedVersions, so also disable filelock majors here; a filelock 4 security PR breaks the LiteLLM install.
Skip generic annotation matches that only see a flake URL or folded scalar marker.
Keep current SHA pins when the annotated release version is unchanged.
